101.dialogue: The race has started. I can't wait to see who'll win.

102.dialogue: Allow me to play you a victory song.

103.dialogue: You'll choose me? Aww, thanks. You're my dear racer♡

104.dialogue: Listen to this intense song and focus.

105.dialogue: Going slow is fine, too. It's safer.

107.dialogue: Keep it up! The finish line is in sight!

108.dialogue: That's the spirit! Just like that!

109.dialogue: Heehee. I knew you'd pull through.

111.dialogue: Not bad at all. I thought you'd lose your cool!

112.dialogue: What? The record? You did break the top speed record.

113.dialogue: Heheh. Can't get enough of my support, can ya?

114.dialogue: It might not look like it, but I AM rootin' for ya. Don't get your ass kicked.

115.dialogue: Took you a while. Had any technical problems? C'mon, victory's just 'round the corner.

116.dialogue: I'm rooting for ya. Just gotta believe in yourself.

117.dialogue: Reckon you can set a new record?

118.dialogue: I'm cheerin' for ya. Ain't no way you're gonna lose.

119.dialogue: Heh! I can already taste the gold trophy.

121.dialogue: You're ready for the race. Let's stay in peak condition.

122.dialogue: Let us thank the Holy Iris for its blessings. Granted, this was more thanks to your talent, Commander.

123.dialogue: Together, let us seize victory once more.

124.dialogue: I'm praying for you. Continue onward.

125.dialogue: Do you think you should service your car one more time?

126.dialogue: Safety first. Let's keep moving forward diligently.

127.dialogue: I will judge you based on your placing. Okay, that was a joke. Slow and steady wins the race.

128.dialogue: You're getting better. Have the blessings given you new talent?

129.dialogue: I saw it. Victory awaits your arrival.

131.dialogue: Commander, the camera is ready! Let's film today's track vlog. Three, two, one... Rolling!

132.dialogue: Perfect! Don't forget to leave a Like to boost the video!

133.dialogue: Whoa! You really know what it means to be the best partner, Commander!

134.dialogue: Slow and steady wins the race~ I'll edit this part to be super moody.

135.dialogue: Don't rush too much. Safety first, remember?

136.dialogue: Just like that, Commander! You look even cooler than usual right now!

137.dialogue: Ooh, good pace! The speed and the cheers are perfect!

138.dialogue: Go, go, go! All the way to the finish line, Commander!

139.dialogue: Wow! This baby accelerates like nothing I've ever seen before!

141.dialogue: Hmm... The view is perfect. Let's get ready to go, Commander.

142.dialogue: Oh? Already at the goal? Very impressive, Commander.

143.dialogue: You're still going? *sigh*... Fine. Switching could be troublesome.

144.dialogue: Take it slowly, if you'd like. At least it feels smoother this way...

145.dialogue: This speed is on the leisurely side... but that, too, is part of the racing experience.

146.dialogue: This pace is just right for me. It's not tiring, but not too lax, either.

147.dialogue: Your route is looking good. Keep up this pace, and we should make it to the finish line with ease.

148.dialogue: Oh? You're awfully motivated, Commander... Then I'll take this seriously, too.

149.dialogue: An impressive pace. Victory shouldn't be far off for long.

151.dialogue: Heehee... Let me see your prowess on the track.

152.dialogue: Well done. That was an impressive lap. I've noted down your data and routing information.

153.dialogue: Heehee, do you want me by your side? If you must have me around, then I will never leave you.

154.dialogue: Commander, the key to victory lies beneath a calm bearing.

155.dialogue: There's nothing wrong with cautious driving. Victory cannot come without safely reaching the finish line.

156.dialogue: Don't lose your rhythm. Press onward!

157.dialogue: Very good! Keep it up, and let your engine roar!

158.dialogue: Keep up that momentum and carve a path forward.

159.dialogue: Heehee, very smooth acceleration. Victory is within reach.
